observations.description: Read-only advisory-only dashboard. No execution imports, no outbound client imports (urllib.request not present; urllib.parse used for URL parsing only). trading_authority=False, live_trading_permitted=False, advisory_only=True.
Cannot bind outside loopback: LOOPBACK_HOSTS = {127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost}. Non-loopback host rejects with PaperDashboardError. Port validated 1-65535.
POST rejects with 405 method not allowed. PUT/DELETE not implemented (501). Only GET and HEAD serve content.
Adapter checkpoint checksums verified: payload_sha256 matches, trading_authority=False at payload and gateway level, wrong schema rejects, tampered checksum rejects.
Malformed/oversized/symlinked/unsupported evidence fails closed. Symlinks reject as unsafe. Oversized rejects. Missing required rejects. Empty rejects.
Only closed BTC 15-minute candles accepted: symbol must be BTC, timeframe must be 15m, is_closed must be true. Non-BTC, wrong timeframe, not closed all reject. Chronology must be strictly increasing.
Missing paper-session evidence displayed honestly: paper.available=False, orders=[], receipts=[]. No fabricated equity, balance, positions, or P&L.
P&L unavailable without authoritative fill-price and mark-to-market ledger: performance.available=False, reason='AUTHORITATIVE_FILL_PRICE_AND_MARK_TO_MARKET_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE'.
Snapshot IDs deterministic and content-addressed: SHA-256 of canonical core. Identical inputs produce identical snapshots.
HTML escaping: JavaScript esc() function escapes &, <, >, ", ' to prevent XSS. Order fields (order_id, state, quantity, filled_quantity, notional) use esc().

Security headers: Cache-Control=no-store, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Content-Security-Policy with default-src 'self', object-src 'none', frame-ancestors 'none'. Verified via actual HTTP response.

No outbound network clients (requests, httpx, aiohttp, socketio, paramiko, smtplib not imported). No execution-module imports. http.server is inbound server only. urllib.parse is URL parsing utility, not outbound client.
PowerShell wrapper: binds 127.0.0.1, uses monitoring.paper_dashboard_v1 module, Python runtime checked, ErrorActionPreference=Stop, no mutation cmdlets, no credentials.

Actual localhost HTTP behavior tested: GET / returns HTML, GET /api/snapshot returns JSON with trading_authority=false, HEAD works, POST returns 405, unknown routes return 404, security headers present on both HTML and JSON responses.

accepted_after_correction: test_no_outbound_client_imports (corrected: urllib.parse is URL parsing utility, not outbound client — removed from forbidden set, separately verified urllib.request not imported)
test_snapshot_has_security_headers (corrected: CSP header value contains policy directives, not the header name — check 'default-src' in CSP value)
